description: This report displays subjects with inconsistencies between ACDC form and subject/study medication status forms.
columnHeading:
1.  Country
2.  Site
3.  Subject Number
4.  Status form
5. Visit
6. Trial segment
7. Date of assessment
8.  Status of Subject/Study Med
9. ACDC Question
10. Associated with COVID - 19
11. Scenario
logic:
Scenario 1:

ACDC. Was the Discontinued Status of the Subject for the Study, Recorded on the DS01 Form, Associated With COVID-19? <> Null
AND
DS01.Select the Status of the Subject for the Study <> “Discontinued”.

OR

ACDC.Was the Discontinued Status of Subject at the End of the Imaging/Efficacy Assessments Recorded on the OEDRA Form Associated With COVID-19? <> Null
AND
OEDRA.Status of Subject at End of This Trial Segment <> “Discontinued” in one of the visits entered in supporting document.

OR

ACDC.Was the Discontinued Status of the Subject at the End of All Study Treatments Recorded on the PMST Form Associated With COVID-19? <> Null
AND
PMST.Status of Subject at end of all Study Treatments<> “Discontinued” in one of the visits entered in supporting document.

OR

Was the Discontinued Status of Study Medication at the End of [Trial Segment] Recorded on the [PMS1X] Form, Associated With COVID-19?<> Null
AND
Corresponding PMS1/PMS1A. Status of Study Medication at the End of This Trial Segment <> “Discontinued” in one of the visits entered in supporting document.

OR
ACDC. Was the Discontinued Status of Subject at End of This [Trial Segment] Recorded on the [PMS1X] Form, Associated With COVID-19?<>Null
AND
Corresponding PMS1/PMS1A. Status of Subject at End of This Trial Segment <> “Discontinued” in one of the visits entered in supporting document.

OR
ACDC. Was the Discontinued Status of Subject at End of This [Trial Segment] Recorded on the [PMS1X] Form
AND
Corresponding PMS1/PMS1A. Status of Subject at End of This Trial Segment <> “Discontinued” in one of the visits entered in supporting document.

Scenario 2:

DS01.Select the Status of the Subject for the Study = “Discontinued”  AND DS01.Date of Disposition => 1-Dec-2019
AND
ACDC. Was the Discontinued Status of the Subject for the Study, Recorded on the DS01 Form, Associated With COVID-19? = Null

OR

OEDRA.Status of Subject at End of This Trial Segment = “Discontinued” AND OEDRA.Date of Assessment => 1-Dec-2019
AND
ACDC. Was the Discontinued Status of Subject at the End of the Imaging/Efficacy Assessments Recorded on the OEDRA Form Associated With COVID-19? = Null

OR

PMST. Status of Subject at end of all Study Treatments = “Discontinued” AND PMST.Date of Assessment => 1-Dec-2019
AND
ACDC.Was the Discontinued Status of the Subject at the End of All Study Treatments Recorded on the PMST Form Associated With COVID-19? = Null

OR

PMS[X].Status of Study Medication at the End of This Trial Segment= “Discontinued” AND PMS[X].Date of Assessment => 1-Dec-2019
AND
Corresponding  ACDC. Was the Discontinued Status of Study Medication at the End of [Trial Segment] Recorded on the [PMS1X] Form, Associated With COVID-19?= Null

OR
PMS[X].Status of Study Medication at the End of This Trial Segment= “Discontinued” AND PMS[X].Date of Assessment => 1-Dec-2019
AND
Corresponding  ACDC. Was the Discontinued Status of Subject at End of This [Trial Segment] Recorded on the [PMS1X] Form, Associated With COVID-19? = Null

Note 1: Report uses Mandatory supporting document to correlate the PMS1[X] with the matching trial segment, visit and ACDC item.

Note 2: The report will only consider Randomized Subjects: The report will only consider Randomized Subjects: Subjects who have "--" in their Subject Number

Note 3: The column 9 will populate the corresponding ACDC question text of the item that was completed or is expected to be completed

Note 4: For scenario 1, exclude OEDRA.Status of Subject at End of This Trial Segment = "Not Applicable"or "Not Done"; exclude PMS1A. Status of Study Medication at the End of This Trial Segment = "Not Applicable" or "Not Done".

Note 5: The number of rows in the supporting document will be represented in the Report Header as "# of rows for Supporting doc".

Requires supporting document to be named ACDC001_supp_</Vxxxxxxx>.csv and will contain the following columns and associated content:

  1. Disposition Form – Enter PMS1 or form variation and/or OEDRA. No need to provide supporting document for DS01.
2. Visit - Enter the visit Mnemonic per T&E in which the disposition form is expected
3. Trial Segment Reference –Enter the “Trial Segment Reference” as it is in the ACDC Question. (In most cases this matches the “Trial Segment Reference” in the PMS1 or form variation). Only applicable for PMS1 or form variation, for other forms enter NA.
4. ACDC Question – Enter the ACDC Question from the ACDC form that is associated with the “Disposition Form” and “Trial Segment Reference”

e.g.
Disposition Form, Visit,Trial Segment Reference, ACDC Question

PMS1,Discontinuation Visit,Treatment,Was the Discontinued Status of Study Medication at the End of This Treatment Recorded on the PMS1 Form, Associated With COVID-19?
PMS1,Crossover End of Treatment, End of Cross Over Treatment,Was the Discontinued Status of Study Medication at the End of This Cross Over Treatment Recorded on the PMS1 Form, Associated With COVID-19?
PMS1A,Follow-up Day 30, End of First Course Follow-up,Was the Discontinued Status of Subject at End of This First Course Follow-up Recorded on the PMS1A Form, Associated With COVID-19?
PMS1A,Crossover Follow-up Day 30, End of Cross Over Follow-up,Was the Discontinued Status of Subject at End of This Cross Over Follow-up Recorded on the PMS1A Form, Associated With COVID-19?

If supporting doc is not provided, display the message as "ACDC001_JR_STD Supporting Document Not Present for This Trial".
reportScenarios:
Scenario 1a: Output Yes

Discontinued Status is completed in ACDC form AND corresponding Status in DS01/OEDRA/PMST/PMS1/PMS1A is “Completed” or Blank.

Scenario 1b: Output No

Discontinued Status is completed in ACDC form and corresponding Status in DS01/OEDRA/PMST/PMS1/PMS1A is “Discontinued” AND Date of assessment is on or after 1-Dec-2019.

Scenario 2a: Output Yes

Status in DS01/OEDRA/PMST/PMS1/PMS1A is “Discontinued” with Date of assessment on or after 1-Dec-2019 and the corresponding Discontinued Status in ACDC form is blank.

Scenario 2b: Output No

Status in DS01/OEDRA/PMST/PMS1/PMS1A is “Completed” or Blank or  Date of assessment is prior to 1-Dec-2019.

description: This report will display inconsistencies between the subject status associated to COVID-19 recorded in ACDC form and the information in Adverse Event form.
columnHeading:
1. Country

2. Site

3. Subject Number

4. Status Form

5. Form Date

6. Trial Segment

7. ACDC Response

8. Scenario
logic:
Logic 1:
Logic 1.1: OEDRA form is present in study AND
(ACDC. Was the Discontinued Status of Subject at the End of the Imaging/Efficacy Assessments Recorded on the OEDRA Form Associated With COVID-19? = Y) AND (OEDRA. Status of Subject at End of This Trial Segment = DISCONTINUED - ADVERSE EVENT) AND (There is no AE Term contains 'COVID' OR AE PT contains any of the words listed in Note 1)
OR
Logic 1.2: PMST form is present in study AND
(ACDC. Was the Discontinued Status of the Subject at the End of All Study Treatments Recorded on the
PMST Form Associated With COVID-19? = Y) AND (PMST. Status of Subject at end of all Study
Treatments = DISCONTINUED - ADVERSE EVENT) AND (There is no AE Term contains 'COVID' OR AE PT that contains any of the words listed in Note 1)
OR
Logic 1.3:
For each row of the supporting document:
Matching ACDC question = Y AND (There is no AE Term contains 'COVID' OR AE PT contains any of the words listed in Note 1)
AND (Disposition form(PMS1). Status of Study Medication at the End of This Trial Segment= DISCONTINUED - ADVERSE EVENT OR Disposition form(PMS1A). Status of Subject at End of This Trial Segment= DISCONTINUED - ADVERSE EVENT) for the corresponding trial segment
Example of Logic 1.3:
If in supporting document, there is a row as the following:
•	First Course, PMS1, Was the Discontinued Status of Study Medication at the End of This First Course Recorded on the PMS1 Form, Associated With COVID-19?
Then output will be produce if for the PMS1 with Trial Segment Reference as First Course the Status of Study Medication at the End of This Trial Segment is Discontinued – Adverse Event and in ACDC the question “Was the Discontinued Status of Study Medication at the End of This First Course Recorded on the PMS1 Form, Associated With COVID-19?” is Yes and in There is no AE with AE Term that contains 'COVID' OR with AE PT that contains any of the words listed Note 1.
Logic 2:
AE Term contains 'COVID' OR AE PT contains any of the words listed on Note 1 AND AE.Outcome of AE= FATAL
AND
(
Logic 2.1: OEDRA form is present in study AND
(OEDRA. Date of Assessment >= DS01.Date of Disposition) AND (ACDC. Was the Discontinued Status of Subject at the End of the Imaging/Efficacy Assessments Recorded on the OEDRA Form Associated With COVID-19? WITHIN (N,U))
OR
Logic 2.2: PMST form is present in study AND
(PMST. Date of Assessment >= DS01.Date of Disposition) AND (ACDC. Was the Discontinued Status of the Subject at the End of All Study Treatments Recorded on the PMST Form Associated With COVID-19? WITHIN (N,U))
OR
Logic 2.3:
(ACDC. Was the Discontinued Status of the Subject for the Study, Recorded on the DS01 Form, Associated With COVID-19? WITHIN (N,U))
OR
Logic 2.4:
For each row of the supporting document:
Matching ACDC question WITHIN (N,U) AND (Disposition form(PMS1/PMS1A).Date of Assessment >= DS01.Date of Disposition) for the corresponding trial segment
Example of Logic 2.4:
If in supporting document there is a row as the following:
•	First Course, Cycle 1, Discontinuation Visit, PMS1, Was the Discontinued Status of Study Medication at the End of This First Course Recorded on the PMS1 Form, Associated With COVID-19?
Then output will be produce if for the PMS1 with Trial Segment Reference as First Course has a Date of Assessment equal or greater than DS01 date of disposition and the question “Was the Discontinued Status of Study Medication at the End of This First Course Recorded on the PMS1 Form, Associated With COVID-19?” is answered as No or Unknown
)
Note1:  consider any AE PT (codified term) that contains any of the following
- COVID-19
- SARS-CoV-2
- SARS COV2
- SARS Coronavirus 2
- SARS Coronavirus

*Report should identify the listed as key words e.g: If AE PT is “SARS-COV-2 sepsis” outputs is expected since it contains “SARS-CoV-2”

Note 2: Please exclude deleted AE records
Note 3: Please display one output for each sub-logic met (1.1 , 1.2 , 2.1…)
Note 4: For Logic 2 output should be produce if the first statement and one of the sub-logics is met
Note 5: Requires supporting document to be named ACDC002_supp_<xxxxxxx>.csv and  will contain the following columns and associated content: 1 row for each  variation of PMS1.
1) Trial Segment - As specified in the trial segment reference item on the PMS1 or PMS1A form
2) Disposition form - PMS1 or PMS1A
3) Matching ACDC question – Question of ACDC that corresponds to the PMS1 variation according to trial segment reference

E.g.
Trial Segment, Disposition form, Matching ACDC question
First Course, PMS1, Was the Discontinued Status of Study Medication at the End of This First Course Recorded on the PMS1 Form, Associated With COVID-19?
Follow-Up First Course, PMS1A, Was the Discontinued Status of Subject at End of This Follow-Up First Course Recorded on the PMS1A Form, Associated With COVID-19?
Second Course, PMS1, Was the Discontinued Status of Subject at End of This Second Course Recorded on the PMS1 Form, Associated With COVID-19?
reportScenarios:
A –Yes

There is a subject status associated to COVID-19 as "Yes" in ACDC form and Reason for Discontinuation in [PMS1, PMST and/or OEDRA] is "Adverse Event", but there is no COVID-19 adverse event in AE form with onset date prior or equal to the Date of Assessment in the disposition form.

B- No

There is a subject status associated to COVID-19 as "Yes" in ACDC form and Reason for Discontinuation in [PMS1, PMST and/or OEDRA] is "Adverse Event", and there is a COVID-19 adverse event in AE form with onset date prior or equal to the Date of Assessment in the disposition form.

C –Yes

There is a subject with a fatal COVID-19 adverse event but the subject status associated to COVID-19  in ACDC form is completed as “No” or “Unknown” for a PMS1, PMST, DS01 and/or OEDRA with a date after or on the same date than the start date of the AE.

D –No

There is a subject with a fatal COVID-19 adverse event but the subject status associated to COVID-19  in ACDC form is completed as “Yes” for a PMS1, PMST, DS01 and/or OEDRA with a date after or on the same date as the start date of the AE.

E –No

There is a subject with a fatal COVID-19 adverse event but the subject status associated to COVID-19  in ACDC form is completed as “No” or “Unknown” for a PMS1, PMST, DS01 and/or OEDRA with a date before the start date of the AE.

description: The report generates a listing of Adverse Events with relative days to period.  Last visit is the final visit where there is a date of visit recorded.  Time Since Last Dose is is the amount of days, hours, and minutes that have elapsed since the last dose begin date where the dose amount is greater than 0.  Days Relative to Start of Trial are the number of days from the first visit date to the onset date of the AE.  Days Relative to Start of Period are the number of days from the date of visit of the period in which the AE occurred to the onset date of the AE.  PLEASE NOTE:  The phase and period in which the AE occurred is based upon the AE Onset Date in relation to the Date of Visit.  The timing of any study medication administration at that period is not considered.  The AE will fall into the phase and period where the AE onset date is equal to or after the date of visit for that visit, and prior to the date of visit of the next visit.

logic:
The report is a listing and will output as follows:

Column 3: Display the Total Number of Subjects per site for the corresponding treatment phase with the "DATE OF VISIT" of "First Visitmnemonic of Treatment Phase" NOT NULL in the eCRF from "Group 1"

Column 4: Display the Total Number of subjects per site for the corresponding treatment phase with at least one AE record with the "OVERALL ACTION TAKEN" = "Discontinued" in the eCRF from "Group 4 "

Column 6: Display the Total Number of records per site for the corresponding treatment phase with the "STATUS" = "Adverse Event" in the eCRF from "Group 5"

Notes:

1-	Erroneous visits and deleted records are excluded from programming
2-	Report should be programmed for randomized subjects only
3-	STUDY PHASE SUPPORTING DOCUMENT NOTE:

	This supporting document is only required to be created once per trial. If it was already created and uploaded, there is no need to duplicate it.

The supporting document should be named as study_phase_supp_</Vxxxxxxx>.csv and will contain the following columns and associated content:

One row for each Treatment Phase

1. Phase Order: required, the order on which phases will appear on protocol
2. Treatment Phase: name of each study phase (Intial Treatment Phase, Neodjuvant Phase, Second Course Phase)
3. First Visitmnemonic of Treatment Phase: required, the first visit on which treatment is expected to be administered on each phase.

e.g.

Phase Order,Treatment Phase,First Visitmnemonic of Treatment Phase
1, Initial Treatment Phase, Cycle 1
2, Second Course Phase, Cycle 1 Course 2
3, Crossover Phase, Crossover Cycle 1

The actual information provided by the optional supporting doc can be outputted by selecting Y in the parameter "Study Phase Page".

The report logic should be checked within the same treatment phase defined in the supporting document.

For example, if user provides two Treatment Phases in supporting document like below:

Phase Order, Treatment phase, First Visitmnemonic of Treatment Phase
1,Initial Treatment Phase,Cycle 1
2,Second Course Phase,Second Course Cycle 1

The treatment phase will be identified as following:

Initial Treatment Phase: Cycle 1 <= Date < Second Course Cycle 1
Second Course Phase: Second Course Cycle 1 <= Date

Date includes: "ONSET DATE" in eCRF from "Group 2", "DATE OF ASSESSMENT" in eCRF from "Group 3"

The forms DS01 and DS02 will be considered as part of the last treatment phase initiated for a subject, for example, if the trial has 2 treatment phases and for subject 1 the last treatment phase initiated was phase 1 then the DS01/DS02 will be considered as part of phase 1, if for subject 2 the last treatment phase initiated was phase 2 then the DS01/DS02 will be considered as part of phase 2.

4-	AE001_AGG_supp_doc explanation:

This supporting document contains the information that is used for programming to allow the report to have the flexibility enough to get updated at any time with a simple update in the supp doc instead of resubmitting a new spec

The report builder will link the spec with the supp doc using the “STANDARDIZED ITEMQUESTION”

Layout Notes:

1-	Column 5 will display the Formmnemonic using the eCRF from "Group 5"
2-	Column 7 will display the result of the following operation:

Number of Forms as Discontinued due to AE per site for the corresponding treatment phase/Number of Randomized Subjects per Site and for the corresponding treatment phase

e.g. 1

Number of Forms as Discontinued due to AE per site for the initial treatment phase = 8/Number of Randomized Subjects per Site and for the initial treatment phase = 10

Result = 0.80

e.g. 2

Number of Forms as Discontinued due to AE per site for the crossover phase = 3/Number of Randomized Subjects per Site and for the crossover phase = 5

Result: 0.60

3-	Column 8 will display the treatment phase name as specified in the column 2 of the study_phase_supp_</VXXXXXXX>.csv
reportScenarios: As per the defined logic and test data

description: This report lists subjects with gaps or overlaps in Toxicity Grade Dates, with AE Onset Date not equal to the earliest Toxicity Grade Onset Date OR with AE End Date that is not equal to the latest Toxicity Grade Stop Date.
columnHeading:
1. Country

2. Site

3. Subject Number

4. AE Seq

5. AE Term

6. AE Onset Date

7. AE End Date

8. Tox Grade Onset Date

9. Tox Grade Stop Date

10. Error Message
logic:
This report lists subjects with the following conditions:

1) Add entry Toxicity Grade Date overlaps. Output an error message that says "Overlap with Tox Grade Onset dd-mon-yyyy and Tox Stop dd-mon-yyyy"

2) Add entry Toxicity Grade Date gaps. Output an error message that says "Gap with previous Tox Grade Onset dd-mon-yyyy and Tox Stop dd-mon-yyyy"

3) AE Onset Date does not equal the minimum date of Toxicity Grade Onset Date in the add entry section of the same AE. Output an error message that says "AE Onset not earliest Tox Grade Onset"

4a) AE End Date does not equal the maximum date of Toxicity Grade Stop Date in the add entry section of the same AE. Output an error message that says "AE End not latest Tox Grade Stop"

4b) AE End Date is ongoing but there is no blank Toxicity Grade Stop Date in the add entry section of the same AE. Output an error message that says "AE End not latest Tox Grade Stop"

4c) AE End Date has a date but there is a blank Toxicity Grade Stop Date in the add entry section of the same AE. Output an error message that says "AE End not latest Tox Grade Stop"

Report should not display deleted records.

Add-entry records with both dates as UNK/ND/NA are not be considered.

If "Randomized only" parameter selection checkbox is checked, the report should only output subjects with Randomization number that is not null.

Report can be limited by date and time stamps of changed data so that incremental reports can be run.  This will enable teams to perform review in accordance with GDP AE Reporting.

logic:
This report outputs 1 row per each new record.  When data within the report are changed, the entire record would output with the changed information.  If more than 1 datapoint changes within the report period, there will be a separate record for each change.   The report looks at new and changed information within the period specified on the prompt page.

Non-Serious AE is any AE where all  serious AE criteria are null  and Adverse Events.AEAECLINTRC ~ Is the AE an Event of Clinical Interest = No or is null

New or Changed Fields to be included:

Adverse Events.AE Term,

Adverse Events.AEAESERHOSPCB ~ Inpatient hospitalization or prolongation of hospitalization ~ Serious Criteria,

Adverse Events.AEAESERCANCB ~ Cancer ~ Serious Criteria,

Adverse Events.AEAESERLIFECB ~ Immediately life threatening ~ Serious Criteria,

Adverse Events.AEAESERDISABCB ~ Persistent or significant disability incapacity ~ Serious Criteria,

Adverse Events.AEAESERCONGCB ~ Congenital anomaly birth defect ~ Serious Criteria ,

Adverse Events.AEAESERODCB ~ Overdose ~ Serious Criteria,

Adverse Events.AEAESERSIMECB ~ Other important medical event ~ Serious Criteria,

Adverse Events.AEAESERDTHCB ~ DeathEvent reported in autopsy as cause of death ~ Serious Criteria,

Adverse Events.AEAECLINTRC ~ Is the AE an Event of Clinical Interest

New or Changed AE - Display "New" the first time a record is submitted.  Display "Changed" anytime that a datapoint is added or changed to the record after initial submission

The latest transaction date time should be included in the header as the Last DB Refresh.

logic:
This report generates a listing of Study Medication data including Study Medication, Blinding, Scheduled Time, Dose Begin Date/Time, Dose End Date/Time, Dose Amount, Units Taken, Frequency, Location, Route, Formulation, and Reason for Dose Variation.

This report should not display deleted records. Records in erroneous visits should not be considered

The phase and period in which the medication is administered is based upon the Medication Start Date in relation to the Date of Visit.  The timing of any study medication administration at that period is not considered.  The Study Medication will fall into the phase and period where the medication start date is equal to or after the date of visit for that visit, and prior to the date of visit of the next visit. The ‘Period’ field on the Study Medication form will also output in the report to ensure consistency with the ‘Period’ field on the Date of Visit form.
